sources.label: TreyEx Gaming - Clean The Library Guide (upgrade list and effects)
Roblox games API - Clean The Library experience description (confirms upgrades exist as a system)

meta.notes: Upgrades are the Star Points upgrade tree, separate from the milestone-unlocked Magic Abilities system. Cards show only upgrade name and effect; no Star Point costs or per-level numbers are sourced, so those are omitted rather than guessed. Per-upgrade icons are not reliably available without in-game capture, so the catalog launches image-light.

items.name: Magnet
items.effect: Pulls nearby books from the collection you are working on toward you, so you gather them without chasing each one down.
items.cardSummary: Magnet speeds up collecting. When you are clearing a book set, nearby matching books drift toward you instead of needing you to walk to each one.

items.name: Galore
items.effect: Makes books from the collection you are working on easier to spot and find around the library.
items.cardSummary: Galore is a finding upgrade. It helps you locate the books you still need for the current collection instead of searching the whole library by eye.

items.name: Scan
items.effect: Highlights the correct bookshelf for the book you are currently holding, so you know exactly where it belongs.
items.cardSummary: Scan removes the guesswork from shelving. While carrying a book, it marks the shelf that book goes on so you can drop it off without hunting.

items.name: Auto-Organize
items.effect: Automatically sorts the books in your inventory for you.
items.cardSummary: Auto-Organize is a convenience upgrade. It keeps your held books in order on its own, cutting down the manual sorting you do between shelf runs.

items.name: Speed
items.effect: Increases how fast your character moves around the library.
items.cardSummary: Speed is a movement upgrade. Faster walking means quicker trips between book piles and shelves, which adds up over a full cleanup.

items.name: Jump
items.effect: Increases how high your character can jump.
items.cardSummary: Jump is a movement upgrade. A higher jump helps you reach raised areas and move over obstacles while you work through the library.
